final: WITH media_rates AS (SELECT m.Name, CAST(SUM(t.Bytes) AS FLOAT) / CAST(SUM(t.Milliseconds) AS FLOAT) as rate, COUNT(t.TrackId) as track_count FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes IS NOT NULL GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name), mean_rate AS (SELECT AVG(rate) as mean_rate FROM media_rates) SELECT mr.Name, mr.rate, mr.track_count, mr.rate - mean_rate.mean_rate as rate_minus_mean FROM media_rates mr CROSS JOIN mean_rate WHERE mr.rate > mean_rate.mean_rate ORDER BY mr.rate DESC
